entry.title: CU Boulder's LEGO campus comes to life

media:group.media:title: CU Boulder's LEGO campus comes to life
media:group.media:description:
It took 150 years to build CU Boulder’s story. This version came together a little faster. 🧱✨
Watch a time-lapse as CU Boulder’s LEGO campus takes shape. You can see this installation in the Regent Administrative Center lobby soon.
Learn more about CU Boulder’s 150th anniversary history and events ↓ https://bit.ly/4t3WlDn

entry.title: Flying virtual skies for engineering education

media:group.media:title: Flying virtual skies for engineering education
media:group.media:description:
The Undergraduate Flight Simulation Studio is a new facility at the University of Colorado Boulder.
Students in the Ann and H.J. Smead Department of Aerospace Engineering Sciences can test new engineering designs to see how they affect airplanes in flight in the new flight simulators.
Read more in CU Boulder Today: https://bit.ly/4zK1hQh

entry.title: Bill Nye 'the Science Guy' sparks inspiration at CU Boulder leadership series

media:group.media:title: Bill Nye 'the Science Guy' sparks inspiration at CU Boulder leadership series
media:group.media:description:
In the words of Bill Nye "You will, dare I say it, change the world!"
Thank you to the Center for Leadership for hosting the Leo Hill Speaker Series event, where students, faculty, staff and the community walked away inspired to progress innovations in science and beyond.

entry.title: Can you trust your weed label?

media:group.media:title: Can you trust your weed label?
media:group.media:description:
An analysis of hundreds of cannabis products bought at Colorado dispensaries shows that most labels don't comply with the law, and THC concentrates tend to be more accurately labeled.
Read more in CU Boulder Today: https://bit.ly/4izh7Y6

entry.title: Celebrating student veterans at CU Boulder

media:group.media:title: Celebrating student veterans at CU Boulder
media:group.media:description:
This Veterans Day, we’re celebrating all veterans in our CU Boulder community. 🇺🇸
Hear how Veteran and Military Affairs (VMA) has helped students build connections, navigate college and find community on campus.
Learn more about the VMA program: https://bit.ly/4kPtvo6

entry.title: Veterans Day concert to celebrate United States 250th and CU Boulder 150th

media:group.media:title: Veterans Day concert to celebrate United States 250th and CU Boulder 150th
media:group.media:description:
The CU Wind Symphony is partnering with the U.S. Air Force Academy Band and the Colorado National Guard’s 101st Army Band to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the United States and the 150th anniversaries of Colorado and CU Boulder. The free concert will be on Wednesday, Nov. 11 at Macky Auditorium and will also be livestreamed.
More about the event: https://bit.ly/3X4zPhI

media:group.media:title: CU Boulder is stronger together
media:group.media:description:
As we mourn the tragic loss of one of our students and the injury of another student, Dean of Students Devin Cramer and Chief of Police Ashley Griffin share a message to our community.
We are one university community. We will get through this together.
Resources for students, faculty and staff are listed at the end of the video.

entry.title: CUriosity: Why do we like to be scared?

media:group.media:title: CUriosity: Why do we like to be scared?
media:group.media:description:
In honor of Halloween, we asked behavioral neuroscientist and fear researcher Elora Williams, PhD, why some people like to be scared and some don’t.
Read more in CU Boulder Today: https://bit.ly/3UwwWFJ

media:group.media:title: Why voting matters to Buffs
media:group.media:description:
Why is voting important to you? 🗳️
With the midterm election coming up on Nov. 3, Chancellor Justin Schwartz asked Buffs why voting matters to them—and why it's important for students to make their voices heard.
Find resources ↓ https://bit.ly/4z4F538

entry.title: CU Boulder State of the Research & Innovation Enterprise presentation—October 2026

media:group.media:title: CU Boulder State of the Research & Innovation Enterprise presentation—October 2026
media:group.media:description:
Massimo Ruzzene, senior vice chancellor for research and innovation and dean of the institutes, highlighted the strength and resilience of CU Boulder’s research and innovation enterprise, including research funding trends, major discoveries and achievements, innovation and economic impact, strategic investments, and expanding partnerships that position the university for continued success.
Learn more: https://www.colorado.edu/researchinnovation/

entry.title: Experience Shine on Norlin before Oct. ends

media:group.media:title: Experience Shine on Norlin before Oct. ends
media:group.media:description:
Just one week left to experience Shine on Norlin. ✨
See CU Boulder’s 150-year story come to life through stunning projections, student artwork, research, history and innovation displayed across Norlin Library. Catch it nightly through the end of October from approximately 6–9 p.m
Learn more about the stories in the projections ↓ https://bit.ly/3UiS8yG

entry.title: CU Boulder scientist inks futuristic tattoos that shapeshift and change colors

media:group.media:title: CU Boulder scientist inks futuristic tattoos that shapeshift and change colors
media:group.media:description:
These aren’t your parents' tattoos. PhotoTat, as they call it, is a color-changing tattoo pigment that can temporarily vanish with light exposure.
Read more in CU Boulder Today: https://bit.ly/47DHSUV

entry.title: Buffs Behind the Lens: The Making of the 150th Documentary | Episode 8

media:group.media:title: Buffs Behind the Lens: The Making of the 150th Documentary | Episode 8
media:group.media:description:
Welcome back to Buffs Behind the Lens, our series taking you inside the making of CU Boulder’s 150th anniversary documentary! 🎬
In this episode, Chancellor Justin Schwartz sits down with Reiland Rabaka, director of the Center for African & African American Studies, to talk about innovation, creative spirit and the joys of working in higher education. Stay tuned for more behind-the-scenes drops throughout our 150th year!

media:group.media:title: Which 'Big Idea' was your favorite?
media:group.media:description:
Our first five big ideas advancing to the next step have been revealed, but the conversation is just beginning. From sustainable AI and brain health to wildfire resilience and space exploration, every big idea sparks a different vision for what's possible.
Hear which initiatives attendees connected with the most and why they're excited about what's ahead for CU Boulder. https://bit.ly/4emqE20
